newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Advanced Communication Systems Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Advanced Communication Systems Inc.

text.p: Company Name Advanced Communication Systems Inc
Total shares to be offered 2.5 million
Shrs offered by shareholders 650,000 Shrs outstanding after ipo 5,636,750
Lead Underwriter A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc

Business: Fairfax, Va., -based company provides communications and information technology services and solutions, predominately to U.S. government agencies and to a lesser extent commercial and international computers. Use of Proceeds: Repayment of debt, including debt incurred to finance S corporation distributions and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions.
